about: The scope of the hidden-character and look-alike checks of the outbox (T247, standing order 16). A review blocks only on a gap in this corpus: a code point or text that a rule or example here decides and a function does not follow, or a class of hidden or look-alike characters that is missing here. The 'outOfScope' entries are accepted in writing and are not gaps. test/hidden-corpus.test.js sweeps every code point against these rules. In a text, {U+XXXX} stands for that code point. A rule is the body of a JavaScript regular expression with the v flag, matched against one code point.

card.reader: People on Discord: the approval card of a message (src/cards.js safeOf). Its 'dropped' count, for the message text and each context text, is the card's Hidden field (src/outboxFlow.js).
card.allowList: A code point stays only when a 'keep' rule matches it. Every other code point is dropped and counted. A white space stays as one space and is not counted. An RGI emoji sequence also stays whole, uncounted (see 'texts'). A 'drop' class with no 'where' meets no keep rule except the joiner rule.

keep.class: a letter that is not default-ignorable
a number, punctuation or symbol, except the backtick, the blank Braille cell and the null notehead
a white space, shown as one space
a non-spacing mark on a letter, at most 3 on one letter
a spacing or enclosing mark on a letter, at most 4 on one letter
the joiner rule: a joiner U+200C or U+200D right after a kept 'joining' letter or mark, when that is a mark or the next code point is 'joining'; never two joiners in a row

drop.class: every default-ignorable code point (F-T247-31: also U+034F, U+17B4, U+17B5 on a letter), except under the joiner rule
a variation selector that is not in a kept emoji sequence
a zero-width character, except under the joiner rule
the backtick, the blank Braille cell and the null notehead
a control, private-use, unassigned or surrogate code point that is not a white space
a mark after punctuation, a space, the start, or anything else that is not a letter
a 4th non-spacing mark on one letter, a 5th spacing or enclosing mark
drop.where: past the limit on a letter

texts.why: an RGI emoji keeps its variation selector
an RGI family keeps its joiners
an RGI flag keeps its tag characters
a Persian word keeps its ZWNJ
a Hindi conjunct keeps its ZWJ
backticks and the blank Braille cell
a zero-width space; a newline is a white space

outOfScope.what: the joiner rule keeps a joiner uncounted, also after a combining mark that a joining script shares with Latin (its scx), such as U+0303 or U+0308: one joiner, so one hidden bit, after each such mark
outOfScope.why: the owner's design (docs/reference.md, the approval card): Persian, Hindi and Bengali words and a Malayalam chillu need the joiners; never two in a row; payload.txt shows each one as an escape

model.reader: A model: sage reads the payload of an approved message (src/outbox.js literal). No person reads it on Discord.
model.allowList: A code point stays raw only when a 'keep' rule matches it and it is not in 'lookalikes'. `"` and `\` stay with a backslash before them. Every other code point is written as \u{HEX}, and the text reads back exactly.

keep.class: a letter or number that is not default-ignorable
a mark that is not default-ignorable, on a kept letter or number or on a mark kept on one

lookalikes.source: by hand (F-T247-34): confusables 18.0.0 does not map it to \

model.lookalikesAbout: The letters and numbers that look like " or \. Every punctuation or symbol outside ASCII is escaped anyway, so only letters and numbers need this list. The test checks that it holds every letter or number whose NFKC holds " or \, or whose confusables 18.0.0 target in src/confusables.json is '' or \.

outOfScope.what: a mark that draws a stroke on a letter, kept raw on it: U+20E5, U+030E, U+030B, U+0338 (and any number of them)
outOfScope.why: the escape grammar stays sound: no raw " or \ gets through, every output reads back, and a model reads the escaped JSON, not the shapes
